results.controlIntent: Implement the security design principle of sufficient documentation in [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

judgment.rationale: The control SA-8(32).v0 requires sufficient documentation as a security design principle for the system or system component. The only evidence collector available — getModelCard — returned null, indicating that no model card exists for the "churn-predictor-v1" model deployed at "churn-predictor-endpoint". A model card is the canonical documentation artifact for ML models, capturing intended use, limitations, risk ratings, and evaluation details. Without any model card or equivalent documentation artifact, the control's requirement for sufficient documentation is entirely unmet. There is no evidence of any documentation substantive enough to satisfy this principle.
gaps: No model card exists for churn-predictor-v1 / churn-predictor-endpoint (getModelCard returned null). A model card documenting intended use, limitations, risk rating, and evaluation details is required to assess sufficiency of documentation.

No alternative documentation artifacts (e.g., system security plan entries, design documents, risk assessments) were retrievable via available tools — human attestation would be needed to confirm whether any out-of-band documentation exists.
